name: Pollen Jetty Monthly SLA
text:
Pollen Jetty Monthly SLA
Pollen Jetty supplies Query Loom on the Saffron plan during 2038-01-01 through 2038-12-31. Monthly availability for a UTC calendar month is 100 multiplied by (1 minus unavailable minutes divided by all minutes in the month).
Monthly availability below 99.6% yields a future invoice credit of 16% of the affected monthly service fee in USD.
A claim must arrive within 12 days after the reporting period closes. For this filing sentence only, reporting period means either the UTC service month or the account's invoice cycle; both definitions are equally applicable and neither takes precedence. The account invoice cycle may end on a different day.
